ms.report:
I am pleased to submit the proof of achievement for Milestone 1, Core Transaction Filtering. This milestone delivers the OgmiosDotnet.BlockchainEvents project: an open-source, rule-based filtering engine that connects to the Cardano blockchain via OgmiosDotnet and emits structured CloudEvents for matched transactions. The submission includes 3 working rule implementations (Minswap swap detection, governance vote filtering, metadata transaction matching), a standardised event schema, 59 passing unit tests, full developer documentation, and a live observability stack.
Proof of Achievement: [link]
Demo Video: [link]

ms.report:
Milestone 2 — Event Delivery Layer
Please find the full Proof of Achievement here:
https://github.com/ItsDaveB/OgmiosDotnet.BlockchainEvents/blob/main/reports/milestone-2/proof-of-achievement.md
This milestone delivers a queue-backed event delivery system with HTTP (CloudEvents) and gRPC endpoints, at-least-once delivery with automatic retry, API documentation with Postman examples, a Docker Compose local setup (14 services), and a benchmark file covering 5 scenarios. A narrated demo video is included in the PoA covering all acceptance criteria.
Beyond the milestone requirements, several additional features have been implemented to strengthen the system for production use:
・Checkpoint persistence with ETag concurrency — sync state saved to Redis with optimistic locking, enabling crash recovery with minimal block re-processing
・Full observability stack — 9 custom Prometheus metrics (counters/gauges/histograms), pre-provisioned Grafana dashboards, and Zipkin distributed tracing
・Multiple consumer types — Dapr pub/sub subscriber, gRPC server-streaming with per-subscriber filtering, and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for browser-based consumption
・React-based event viewer UIs — four live-streaming event viewer instances with pause/clear controls and tabular display (TanStack React Table)
・Circuit breaker and dead letter queue — multi-layer retry policies with exponential backoff and automatic DLQ capture for failed events
・In-memory fan-out with backpressure — EventBroadcaster distributes to gRPC subscribers via bounded channels with DropOldest overflow
・Redis Commander and Dapr Dashboard — included for state inspection and service topology visibility during development

This project is entirely open source. If there are any questions or doubts about any aspect of the deliverables, please refer directly to the repository at https://github.com/ItsDaveB/OgmiosDotnet.BlockchainEvents all source code, configuration, documentation, and tooling are publicly available.
